seoTitle: Clothing Size Converter: US, UK, DE, FR, IT Women and EU Men
metaDescription: Convert women's dress and top sizes between US, UK, DE, FR and IT, and men's shirt letters to EU numbers and chest cm.
intro: Looks up equivalent clothing sizes between common systems from a published reference table.
why:
Clothing sizes are not defined by one standard, and vanity sizing makes labels drift. A table gives a fair starting point, not a promise of fit.

The women's numbers and men's letters come from the Wikipedia article on clothing sizes. For women, enter the number in the system you know. For men, enter a letter, an EU number or a chest size in cm.
howTo: For women pick your system and enter the size; for men enter a letter, EU number or chest cm.
Read the equivalents and then check the brand's own chart.

faq.q: Why does my size differ by brand?
faq.a: Brands use different cuts and vanity sizing. Use the brand's measurements.

faq.q: Where does the table come from?
faq.a: From the Wikipedia article on clothing sizes, as noted in the output.
